Kit summary

Earth-cracking Devil SpearBasic
Deals 360% ATK [Poison] DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] for 2 turns.
Poisonous Rolling ThunderActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Grants all allies [Poison Up II] for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 510% ATK [Poison] DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict 2 layers of [Poison] for 2 turns.
Devil's Longspear Lv.2Each layer of [Evil Hex] additionally increases Mastery by 10%. When Cadrian casts active skills proactively, for every 5 layers of [Evil Hex] owned by self, reduces the skill CD by 1 turn. When [Evil Hex] is stacked to the max layers, casts Poisonous Rolling Thunder 1 more time when casting Rain of Toxic Spears proactively. At the beginning of each wave, Cadrian gains [Demonic Barrier] before the first turn ends. [Demonic Barrier]: Immune to control effects and Turn Meter Reduction.
Devil's Longspear Lv.3Poisonous Rolling Thunder and Rain of Toxic Spears additionally trigger [Poison] once, up to 6 layers can be triggered. At the beginning of each wave, grants [Power of Devil] (at the end of the owner's turns, restores all allies' HP by 200% of Cadrian's ATK and cleanses 3 layers of DoT debuff from them) to allies with the [Control] tag for 2 turns. Besides, for every 1 ally with the [Control] tag deployed, [Power of Devil] also reduces the owner's Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 24%. When 5 allies with the [Control] tag are deployed, the following effects can be triggered once during each wave: When any ally's HP is below 10%, they only take 1 point of DMG at most from this DMG this time. Afterward, Cadrian cleanses all debuffs from all allies and grants them [Power of Devil] for 2 turns.
Devil's PoisoncraftPassive
For every 10 layers of [Poison] inflicted by allies, Cadrian gains 1 layer of [Evil Hex]: Increases [Poison] DMG dealt by 3.6%, up to 20 layers. When an enemy's turn ends, Cadrian inflicts [Severe Ulcer] on them: Increases [Poison] DMG taken by 10% for 2 turns, up to 5 layers.
Rain of Toxic SpearsActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 4 stages of 255% ATK [Poison] DMG each to a single enemy and each stage has a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] for 2 turns. The 4th stage also inflicts [Stun] (this effect cannot be removed) on the target for 1 turn.
Devil's Longspear Lv.1For every 1% initial Mastery owned by Cadrian, he additionally gains 0.5% Effect Hit, up to 100% Effect Hit can be gained through this effect. Each stage of Rain of Toxic Spears removes 1 layer of buff from the target and inflicts 1 layer of [Severe Ulcer] for 2 turns. When any enemy gains [Indomitable], Cadrian cleanses all debuffs from self and acts 1 extra turn. Skill CD: 1 turn.
Devil's Longspear Lv.2Each layer of [Evil Hex] additionally increases Mastery by 10%. When Cadrian casts active skills proactively, for every 5 layers of [Evil Hex] owned by self, reduces the skill CD by 1 turn. When [Evil Hex] is stacked to the max layers, casts Poisonous Rolling Thunder 1 more time when casting Rain of Toxic Spears proactively. At the beginning of each wave, Cadrian gains [Demonic Barrier] before the first turn ends. [Demonic Barrier]: Immune to control effects and Turn Meter Reduction.
Devil's Longspear Lv.3Poisonous Rolling Thunder and Rain of Toxic Spears additionally trigger [Poison] once, up to 6 layers can be triggered. At the beginning of each wave, grants [Power of Devil] (at the end of the owner's turns, restores all allies' HP by 200% of Cadrian's ATK and cleanses 3 layers of DoT debuff from them) to allies with the [Control] tag for 2 turns. Besides, for every 1 ally with the [Control] tag deployed, [Power of Devil] also reduces the owner's Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 24%. When 5 allies with the [Control] tag are deployed, the following effects can be triggered once during each wave: When any ally's HP is below 10%, they only take 1 point of DMG at most from this DMG this time. Afterward, Cadrian cleanses all debuffs from all allies and grants them [Power of Devil] for 2 turns.
